part.Name: Description
part.Short: The chrome-womb, primordial vita spills into these defiled lands from these sacred caverns. Birthed in glass, monstrosities and sentients alike climb from its depths. An eternal catalyst pumping life into this treacherous plateau.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Gargantuan legs of blackened steel support a platform of whirring gizmos and mechanical eyes. Its slow, steady gait sends constant tremors through the dirt, bellowing sulfur from its joints as it drains lakes of brimstone with its mandibles. Its claws glow, making a sharp hiss as thermal energy crackles through lattices of thermite.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Sickly pink flesh swells and surges against a veiny sinuous husk, its a shambling mess composed of innumerable hairless humanoids, reptiles and mammalians; whose limbs conjoin with tumorous growths at their core. Amongst the clutter of grasping digits and flailing extremities is the countless faces, faces whose eyes bury into your own frantically searching. They twitch with expressions of horror and then euphoria, remembering when their flesh was taken by the vita.

part.Short: Behind the glass membrane, inside a microcosmic globe, heat gives birth to lobes of molten rock that flow toward their own pyroclastic demise.

part.Short: Shining black elytra flitter on the back of a goat-sized bug, its rear is armed with a fleshy catapult that lobs molten sulfur at its prey.

part.Short: Granules of dust frozen for stony eons marble the dewlap of a giant magenta iguana.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Leathery wings bat shimmering dust off =pronouns.possessive= ray-like aura, and =pronouns.possessive= S-shape bod ripples across their waves of air. =pronouns.Possessive= plumage is blinding with the glint of crystalline shear.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Broken scales and burnt feathers lay in flat tessellation.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The distended jaw of this leviathian bears many hooked teeth, shaped unlike the vinereavers a farmer might bare.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Maybe this is what a madpole is to become, a vicious beast of gargantuan size, jaws lined with thousands of teeth shimmering as it hones in on any sign of life around it.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A dark shadow envelopes this massive serpent, an eerie silence moves with it as you catch its faint appearance here and there, diving between planes of water and void..

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Great wings of cartilage flit on the ocean current in slow methodical motions, its edges glow with luminescence.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Quills tipped in red-tint gleam with the lablights, a weary gaze of golden eyes barely visible behind oval lenses. Their face carries scars of burnt flesh from their various technical exploits gone horribly wrong. The uurshib seems content though, as they tinker, performing diagnostics to the most minute detail. Every once in a while, they pull from their pocket a momento to which they hold a cold, solemn gaze to a photo of times long gone.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: An insectoid whose genes were warped with human lineages, they show high levels of intelligence and to some, an unnerving tendency toward compassion and benevolence.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: To be ogled by the beady eyes of this small insectoid invokes feelings of wonder: why did the precursors see it fit to blend our kinds?

part.Name: Description
part.Short: For insectomamilians and our anesheym, old age accompanies starvation, a fate exhibited in this one with its loose hanging shell and stiff movements. Their greatest strength is to grow without limit, yet exemplified here it reveals its greatest weakness--if one cannot acquire the sustenance to sustain such a form, then they will wither away to inanition. To the anesheym, hunger is age.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: This feminine insectoid huddles clutches of eggs and young-brood in its many arms; not one of these are this creature's direct offspring--but instead the young of their progenitor. Nevertheless, they show a maternal care that is surely love towards their grublings.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The warrior lineage of the aneshym is the result of select genoclinic reproduction and careful combat conditioning. They stand tall, most adorned in armor latticed from nanites and chitin glaze.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The warrior lineage of the aneshym is the result of select genoclinic reproduction and careful combat conditioning. They stand tall, most adorned in armor latticed from nanites and chitin glaze. Toughened through war-hardened times, the sentinels are the first and foremost to stand before the enemy and the grand progenitor.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Once a devout moonseer who stumbled into the dark places of the anima. They succumbed to the sickness, and with eyes blackened and crazed; the insectoid looks altered and feral, their minds severely addled as its logic is infested by their shadow.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Yel-Deya-Yerah are an order who disciplines themselves in mastering and studying the secrets of the anima. Both in dream and through meditation, these monadic individuals derive great knowledge and power through the dream-plane. This in particular is a novice, denoted by their new-moon robe and their grey apparel.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Yel-Deya-Yerah are an order who disciplines themselves in mastering and studying the secrets of the anima. Both in dream and through meditation, these monadic individuals derive great knowledge and power through the dream-plane. This individual has reached the status 'waxing,' they have delved into the depths of the unconscious and faced the horrors within mostly unscathed.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Yel-Deya-Yerah are an order who disciplines themselves in mastering and studying the secrets of the anima. Both in dream and through meditation, these monadic individuals derive great knowledge and power through the dream-plane. This savant bears the quartered-moon crest of the 'waning,' they are familiar with the anima and ripened by her eidolithic fruits.

part.DisplayName: BloodShell Jar'karunox, Sentinel to the Grand Progenitor

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Rippling intramuscular tissue swells against a brutish-frame of shale-scratched exoskeleton, their spinnerets lick the air from the cusp of their cheeks in a star-like pattern as their globus eyes scan the courtroom eagerly.

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: Ikna-kanti the Windstrafer, Sentinel to the Grand Progenitor

part.Name: Description
part.Short: What could almost be mistaken for a child is instead a petite warrior from a lost proto-cline. Their chitin ripples like disturbed water frozen in the moment, a deep-blue as pristine as sapphire hides hints of glittering green beneath its surface, the sheen breaks the slender silhouette of the creature in a way that makes them difficult to parse with your eyes.

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: {{extradimensional|Grand Progenitor and Wombbearer,}} Shah Zenithera Pandamoriae

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Silver sheets of filmy elytra flare out in the matriarch's arrangement, erecting from the spine of a humanoid vast enough to gaze down at those in her court. A tangerine glow bathes you in sharp cascading patterns as the sun-gold shell of this avatar shimmers against the flame in their cane wielded in one of their many arms. Their dozen-or-so glowing lavender eyes gaze with weariness, undermined by a content smile. The growth of flora and rust about her hips and lower extremities hint this being has nestled here decem millenia.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A writhing, pulsating mass of insect flesh and sinuous muscle, it fuses into the spine of the great Shah, drawing in their infinite gene-stock to be molded into egglings. Future progeny are to be birthed at every fifth hour. Such biomechanical workings is not but one of nature's most elusive enigmas and one would find it hard not to ogle such an incredible specimen ...

part.Short: This is the village crier.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: An anesheym stands before you, her amber-shell smothered in rust and iron-shavings. She lurches forward almost hungrily, an old predator who slays with unearthly experience, undermined only by her unassuming appearance.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: This anesheym scrapamist looms above a mechanical workbench, its various arms working carefully between several projects with ease. Thier chitin-skin is speckled with soot and heat-warped from work, yet it continues unhindered. Ceaselessly, with what even seems like a slight grin on their face.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Joy could not be contained in this shell, breaking through cerulean as emerald heart-like motifs across their petite form. Bubbling energy radiates through their many eyes as their feather-like antennae search eagerly for souls to assist and brood to nurture.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Fire-licked chitin bears a glossy, warped, obsidian-like look and this anesheym wears it proudly. He dons a toque and messy apron, stirring and sorting rations as he works around his kitchen.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Partially habilimented in familiar grey-matter robes, an insectoid being stands with thin; stilt-like legs. A five-eyed gaze meets your own on a familiar human-like face; aether glowing strongly within their pupiless gaze. Adorned with silver-hued hair which rolls to their back and the plump, sacral-abdomen which juts from their lower spine; their feminine form remains only somewhat lost under tribal overalls and a shawl-n'cloak of the Seeker lineage.

tag.Name: staticFaction1

part.Name: Description
